source_query:
WITH q AS (
 SELECT n.adsh,count(DISTINCT n.qtrs) AS durations,
 max(value) FILTER(WHERE qtrs=1 AND uom='USD') AS quarter_value,
 max(value) FILTER(WHERE qtrs=2 AND uom='USD') AS half_year_value
 FROM num n JOIN sub s USING(adsh)
 WHERE s.form='10-Q' AND n.tag='NetIncomeLoss' AND n.ddate=s.period AND n.coreg IS NULL GROUP BY n.adsh)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM sub WHERE form='10-Q') AS all_quarterly,
 count(*) AS eligible, count(*) FILTER(WHERE durations>1) AS multiple_durations,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE quarter_value IS NOT NULL AND half_year_value IS NOT NULL) AS both_usd_periods,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE quarter_value<>half_year_value) AS different_usd_values FROM q

duration_pair_crosscheck.sql:
WITH f AS (
SELECT n.adsh, n.qtrs, n.value FROM num n JOIN sub s USING(adsh)
WHERE s.form='10-Q' AND n.tag='NetIncomeLoss' AND n.ddate=s.period AND n.coreg IS NULL
AND n.uom='USD' AND n.qtrs IN (1,2))
SELECT count(DISTINCT a.adsh) AS filings_with_both_tags,
count(DISTINCT a.adsh) FILTER (WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL AND b.value IS NOT NULL) AS both_with_values,
count(DISTINCT a.adsh) FILTER (WHERE a.value<>b.value) AS different_values
FROM f a JOIN f b USING(adsh) WHERE a.qtrs=1 AND b.qtrs=2
